Q1 is the first question of the booklet and is complete on p01. Q35 is complete at the foot of p05's right column; nothing spills overleaf. [Diagram: A single closed loop. Along the bottom branch is a cell labelled 10 V. From the cell the wire runs up the left side to a left junction, where the circuit splits into two parallel branches that rejoin at a right junction. The UPPER parallel branch carries a 10 \(\Omega\) resistor in series with a 5 \(\mu\)F capacitor. The LOWER parallel branch carries a single 10 \(\Omega\) resistor. From the right junction the wire continues through a third 10 \(\Omega\) resistor, then down the right side back to the cell.]
